Class Camera

java.lang.Object
net.murat.lovert.Camera
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Camera extends Object implements Serializable
Represents the 3D camera viewpoint parameters for the ray tracer. Supports both perspective and orthographic projections with serialization. Fully compatible with single-threaded high-performance loops.
